label: R-act1 from dependence through the two unde bridges, checked
description: Near-transcription (single application): given R-dep, the first unde and the nature in act, the second unde is equivalent to the reception half of R-act1 (undeLoadMap, conjunct 2), so the proof applies that bridge to deliver its own content; the limited half comes from 7de89edb. Own being is read as esse tantum (OWN_BEING_1, DEF ad76481a). Generic in the frame, so it holds on the dependence reading of 'actualized through' as well. It makes the commitment explicit and closes nothing by itself.
